summary: Tested new ActivityFeed feature: GET /api/activities endpoint + ActivityFeed component on HomePage (mobile 390x844 + desktop 1440x900). All backend tests pass (8/8) and frontend renders correctly on both viewports with no regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: ActivityFeed.js loading state returns null (line 39) - consider lightweight skeleton placeholder to avoid layout shift
Stats numbers (127/42/98%) and live counter increment are hardcoded MOCKED on client - acknowledged by problem statement

seed_data.py does NOT clear/seed activities collection at startup automatically - relies on `python seed_data.py` manual run; activities are seeded but seed flow does not delete activities at the top of seed_database() (only inside the activities block), which is correct but worth noting

ActivityFeed renders both mobile and desktop card lists simultaneously in DOM (CSS lg:hidden / hidden lg:grid) which doubles activity nodes on the page - acceptable but consider single-source render via media-query hook
Area field e.g. 'Depok Margonda' is truncated on mobile to max-w-[60px] - currently OK but very narrow names may clip; not a bug
